retrieval_corpus_policy: K02 may use the same evidence rows for both baselines. Preserve original_text, claim_en, conditions, limitations, modality and source locators together. Sources are for traceability, not blindly indexing whole project folders.
claim_en_semantics: Project-agent-authored English paraphrase, not a verbatim manufacturer quotation; no human or domain-expert sign-off is claimed.
scope: generic bearing education; no model-specific or aviation validation
null_policy: Empty PDF page fields mean HTML source; empty local_path/hash only when access limitation is explicit; empty relation evidence only for project_contract/demo_assumption.
